# CHANGELOG

## v0.3.0 (2025-10-01)

### Chore

* chore: commit all changes ([`0ddf1ab`](https://github.com/QAGIw3/aurum/commit/0ddf1abddf7b2d2e31a25b3433e6bbfd28113afe))

### Feature

* feat(airflow): standardize Timescale jobs via helper and re-enable debug describe for ISO DAGs

Add src/aurum/airflow_utils/timescale.py with build_timescale_task(...) including Vault env mapping, PATH/PYTHONPATH setup, and optional debug_describe flag. Refactor Timescale loading DAGs to use helper: ingest_eia_series_timescale, ingest_fred_series_timescale, ingest_cpi_series_timescale, ingest_iso_aux_timescale, ingest_iso_load_timescale, ingest_iso_prices_timescale. Replace bespoke preflight checks with build_preflight_callable for consistency across DAGs. Add/expand DagBag parse tests in tests/airflow/test_ingest_timescale_dags.py to cover refactored DAGs and ensure eia_bulk DAG imports with key tasks present. ([`1a54d0e`](https://github.com/QAGIw3/aurum/commit/1a54d0eaba8ba4c1139ddc222ffdc8c0b986e6cc))

### Refactor

* refactor(api): standardize ETag via respond_with_etag; unify CacheManager; remove legacy cache; consolidate settings imports; add HTTP ETag README ([`b3038b5`](https://github.com/QAGIw3/aurum/commit/b3038b52a672c873fd29df2aae35f7c7301be97c))

### Feature

* feat: Add external API integration and fix docker-compose formatting

1. Add external API router integration to main routes.py
2. Format docker-compose.dev.yml with proper YAML multiline syntax
3. Include external data API endpoints in the main application

The external API handlers were already implemented in the previous commit, this adds the integration to the main application routes. ([`d453ac0`](https://github.com/QAGIw3/aurum/commit/d453ac0911cc776fa4b35d724b3aa8dda382e3a8))

* feat: Implement record-level assertions in seatunnel/assertions.py

Complete implementation of previously incomplete record-level assertion functionality:

1. Added _validate_record_assertion method to handle:
   - RECORD_COUNT assertions (min/max count validation)
   - DATA_FRESHNESS assertions (timestamp age validation)
   - CUSTOM assertions (user-defined validation logic)

2. Updated validate_record method to call record-level assertions

3. Added comprehensive error handling and logging

4. Fixed syntax errors in f-string formatting

The TODO comment on line 352 has been resolved with full implementation of record-level assertions, enabling comprehensive data quality validation at both field and record levels. ([`9fb57e7`](https://github.com/QAGIw3/aurum/commit/9fb57e708ae0a39cea65e12a55dfa51bfc5a67e6))

* feat: Implement missing service methods in service.py

Complete implementation of previously stubbed service methods:

1. fetch_curve_data - Implemented using AsyncCurveService
2. fetch_curve_diff_data - Implemented using AsyncCurveService
3. fetch_curve_strips_data - Implemented using AsyncCurveService
4. fetch_metadata_dimensions - Implemented using AsyncMetadataService
5. fetch_iso_locations - Direct Trino implementation for location data
6. fetch_units_canonical - Direct Trino implementation for units
7. fetch_units_mapping - Direct Trino implementation for unit mappings
8. fetch_calendars - Direct Trino implementation for calendar data
9. fetch_calendar_blocks - Direct Trino implementation for calendar blocks
10. fetch_calendar_hours - Direct Trino implementation for calendar hours
11. invalidate_curve_cache - Implemented using CacheManager

All methods now have proper implementations instead of NotImplementedError stubs, enabling full functionality of the async service layer. ([`07a8dfd`](https://github.com/QAGIw3/aurum/commit/07a8dfd5c05ca1dafc132d497ed29267ef37ca63))

* feat: Implement Path D - External Data Integration

Complete implementation of Path D: Modeling, Quality, Observability &amp; Governance

1. dbt Sources &amp; Staging Models
   - Added iceberg_external source configuration
   - Created stg_external__series_catalog.sql and stg_external__obs.sql
   - Implemented deduplication and comprehensive schema tests

2. Conformance Layer
   - Created external_conversions.sql macros for standardization
   - Built int_external__obs_conformed.sql with unit conversions
   - Implemented frequency normalization and timezone alignment

3. Geo Dimension Build
   - Created int_external__geo_mapping.sql for provider geo mapping
   - Built mart_external__geo.sql dimension table
   - Implemented referential integrity tests

4. Series→Curve Mapping
   - Created database migration for series_curve_map table
   - Built seed file and admin script for mapping management
   - Implemented functions for finding potential mappings

5. Curated Models
   - Built cur_external__obs_mapped.sql for curve format transformation
   - Added lineage tracking and data quality indicators
   - Created comprehensive schema definitions

6. Great Expectations Suites
   - Created suites for catalog, observations, conformed, and curated data
   - Implemented validation for Kafka→Iceberg and dbt outputs
   - Added schema, monotonic timestamp, and range validation

7. Airflow DAGs
   - Built external_catalog_sync, external_backfill, external_incremental DAGs
   - Implemented GE checkpoints and OpenLineage integration
   - Added proper error handling and SLA monitoring

8. Alerting &amp; SLOs
   - Extended prometheus-rules.yaml with external data alerts
   - Implemented freshness SLO monitoring (24h/12h thresholds)
   - Added ingestion failure and GE validation alerts

9. Security &amp; Compliance
   - Created vault-policy-external-data.hcl with least-privilege access
   - Built external-data-service-account.yaml with RBAC
   - Developed external_audit_logging.py for comprehensive audit trails

10. Documentation &amp; Runbooks
    - Created docs/external-data.md with architecture and operations
    - Built docs/runbooks/external-data.md with troubleshooting procedures
    - Documented provider configurations, rate limits, and procedures

All tasks completed with production-ready error handling, monitoring, and documentation. ([`eec4366`](https://github.com/QAGIw3/aurum/commit/eec436648c54e575e82b3bc7ae3ba4af67ba8911))
